subject: Consolidated renewal: retention SLAs & bundled pricing for Datadog / Grafana / Sentry
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@datadog.com>, Grafana Sales <sales@grafana.com>, Marco Salas <marco@sentry.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated renewal request: retention SLAs & bundled pricing

Hi all,

Redwood's observability renewals are up in Q3 and we want to explore a consolidated path that reduces unit cost for log retention while preserving our SLAs. Specifically:

- Datadog: current contract expires 2027-08-31; retention add-on pricing is the primary line item.
- Grafana Cloud: evaluating retention tiers and potential cross-product bundle with dashboards/metrics.
- Sentry: retention add-on for error archives that affects incident analytics costs.

Goal: get indicative commercial terms (list and net pricing), retention SLA options (7/14/30/90 days), and any cross-vendor bundle discounts you can offer if we sign a single procurement package or Marketplace contract.

Attachments: procurement_summary_v1.xlsx (internal), please review and include a quote doc if handy.

Can you reply with preliminary shot-clocks and a one-page quote by EOD Thursday (2027-05-13)? We'll consolidate and feed to Procurement for PO creation.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Procurement (Observability)
Redwood Inference
[attachment: procurement_summary_v1.xlsx]
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@datadog.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 12:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal request: retention SLAs & bundled pricing

Hi Tessa / team,

Thanks for the note. Attached is an initial quote for Datadog retention tiers and a bundled discount matrix when Datadog is contracted alongside other telemetry vendors. Highlights:

- 30-day standard retention: base price unchanged.
- 90-day retention add-on: 1.8x base per GB/month; we can offer a 12% credit if you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity.
- Cross-vendor bundle: where Datadog is the lead contract, we can provide a 7% service credit against the retention add-on if the other vendors participate and the consolidated spend exceeds $250k/yr.

I attached datadog_proposal_q2_2027.pdf with line-items and terms. Compliance: SOC 2 report available on request; we can share the latest creds via the secure portal.

Happy to hop on a short call to walk the numbers.

Best,
Anita Rao
Enterprise Account Executive, Datadog
[attachment: datadog_proposal_q2_2027.pdf]
From: Grafana Sales <sales@grafana.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal request: retention SLAs & bundled pricing

Hi Tessa,

Appreciate the outreach. Grafana Cloud's retention add-on pricing is attached; we typically structure cross-product discounts via Marketplace/partner aggregation which simplifies billing and can fold in dashboards + logs for a tiered rate. Two quick notes:

- We can offer a 10% discount on Grafana's log retention add-on when bundled with Grafana Enterprise metrics for annual commitments.
- If Redwood routes billing through a Marketplace channel, there's an additional ~3-5% pass-through discount depending on region (US vs EU).
- Integration note: if you push metrics to Datadog and logs to Grafana, we need to align retention windows to avoid analytics gaps — happy to provide a short runbook.

Attaching grafana_bundle_quote.xlsx. Also: if you want legal-friendly wording for retention SLAs, ask and we'll include sample contract language.

Cheers,
Grafana Cloud Sales Team
[attachment: grafana_bundle_quote.xlsx]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Consolidated renewal request: retention SLAs & bundled pricing

Tessa / team — quick internal read:

- Datadog: 12% credit for 12-month reserved capacity on 90-day retention looks reasonable; need exact net ARR impact.
- Grafana: 10% + marketplace pass-through likely saves a modest amount; confirm billing path.
- Sentry: still pending — ask Marco for firm numbers and pilot terms.

Action items:
1) Laura, can you model the net storage spend under 30 vs 90 day retention using the procurement_summary_v1.xlsx assumptions?
2) Karthik, confirm whether legal will accept a shared Marketplace contract or if we need three separate SOWs.

I'm attaching a quick spreadsheet with baseline projections. Let's get formal quotes by Friday so Procurement can issue an RFP/PO sequence next week.

-Vivek
[attachment: procurement_summary_v1.xlsx]
From: Marco Salas <marco@sentry.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lewis <emma.lewis@acme-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal request: retention SLAs & bundled pricing

Hi Tessa — thanks for including Sentry. A couple points from our side:

- Sentry retention add-on: 90-day archive available; pricing is per-event stored and we can cap monthly invoice if needed.
- Pilot: we recommend a 30-day pilot on a subset of projects to baseline costs, then expand to 90-day for all prod projects.
- Discounts: we can extend a 5% discount on retention charges if bundled into a 12-month master services agreement with Datadog or Grafana, or a combined PO referencing all three vendors.

Attached is our Sentry retention summary and example PO language. Let us know if Procurement needs a template PO.

Regards,
Marco Salas
Account Executive, Sentry
[attachment: sentry_retention_addon.pdf]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@datadog.com>, Grafana Sales <sales@grafana.com>, Marco Salas <marco@sentry.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewal request: retention SLAs & bundled pricing

Thanks everyone — useful first pass. Next steps:

1) Vendor asks: please provide a final one-page net quote (inc. any marketplace pass-throughs) and sample contract language for retention SLAs by 2027-05-20 COB.
2) Redwood asks: Procurement will evaluate combined vs separate SOWs and confirm whether Marketplace billing is acceptable.
3) Meeting: scheduling a 30-minute commercial sync on 2027-05-21 (invite to follow). Please include the sales rep and the legal contact who will negotiate the SLA language.

If you have objections to the timeline, flag today. Thanks again for the fast turnaround.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Procurement (Observability)
Redwood Inference
